tui — Terminal Primitives Plugin

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is kept unchanged.

sa_plugin_tui provides a small, versioned C/SAI ABI covering terminal handle ownership, size queries, UTF-8 output, mode switching, and byte-level input events. It is a low-level host adapter, not a complete TUI application framework.

Basic facts

  • Capability segments: tui.terminal, tui.input, tui.ansi; no plugin dependencies.
  • Extremely small permissions: no filesystem, no network, no child processes; environment variables only TERM, COLORTERM, TERM_PROGRAM, WT_SESSION, TMUX.
  • No CLI commands; the contract is in tui.sai; artifacts are libtui.so / tui.dll.

ABI surface (tui.sai)

FunctionDescription
sa_tui_open(&out_handle)Open a terminal handle
sa_tui_close(^handle)Close a handle
sa_tui_size(handle, &rows, &cols)Query the screen buffer size
sa_tui_write(handle, &bytes, len) / sa_tui_flush(handle)UTF-8 output and flushing
sa_tui_set_mode(handle, mode)Mode switching: 0 cooked / 1 raw / 2 alternate_screen / 3 mouse_tracking
sa_tui_read_event(handle, timeout_ms, &kind, &code)Byte input read with a timeout; event kinds 0 none / 1 byte / 2 resize / 3 eof

Return status convention: 0 ok, 1 unknown_command, 2 io_error, 3 timeout, 4 unsupported, 5 failed, 6 version_mismatch, 7 invalid_descriptor; when no byte is readable it returns 3.

Platform behavior

  • Windows: console handle + screen-buffer size + ConsoleMode raw-mode restoration.
  • Unix: ioctl(TIOCGWINSZ) for size queries, termios for raw mode.
# 构建（在本插件目录内）
zig build test
zig build   # 产出 zig-out/lib/libtui.so 或 zig-out/bin/tui.dll
WarningABI capabilities not yet implemented: decoding escape sequences into typed keyboard/mouse/paste/focus events, resize events and a stable event queue, cell/frame surfaces and diff commits, PTY/ConPTY supervision, and an event-loop polling callback ABI. TUI applications needing these capabilities cannot currently rely on this plugin alone; see its repository README for details.
